newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gran Canaria cargo traffic rose nine pct in Nov 96.
newsitem.headline: Gran Canaria cargo traffic rose nine pct in Nov 96.

text.p: Air cargo traffic at Gran Canaria's airport rose 9.2 percent in November to 3,136 tonnes, the airport authority said.
This takes the accumulated total so far this year to 30,452 tonnes compared with 29,399 tonnes in the same period 1995.
The airport also handled 5,396 tonnes of mail in the 11- month period, up from 4,104 in 1995.
Passenger numbers were seven percent higher in the month at 701,821 but practically unchanged in the year-to-date at almost seven million. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
